final: WITH groups AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_modindex FROM groups) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.avg_modindex - b.mean_modindex) AS avg_above_baseline FROM groups AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.avg_modindex > b.mean_modindex GROUP BY g.weathprofile
